purpose: Common, auditable HBM2 baseline for HBMSim, Ramulator 2.1, and DRAMSys validation.

hbmsim.known_difference: The current channel-level data-bus reservation does not yet model two independent pseudo-channel data buses; the HBM2 SID bit is not yet represented as a hierarchy level.

ramulator2.address_mapper: RoBaRaCoCh with hierarchical trace vectors from address_mapping
ramulator2.known_difference: ReadWriteTrace has no size field and treats each converted line as its fixed HBM2 request payload; V0.3 must expand every neutral 64 B request consistently.

dramsys.known_difference: The stock DRAMSys HBM2 memory specification has a different density/topology. V0.3 must generate a profile-specific memspec before numerical equivalence is claimed.

comparison_status: V0.2 common profile contract: timing and request semantics are explicit. V0.3 is required to normalize burst expansion and remove the recorded SID, data-bus, and DRAMSys density differences.
